email.body1:
Mike, saw Corcentric land CB to digitize its procure-to-pay and partner with Avalara on global e-invoicing.

Momentum like that usually opens more in-market accounts than the team can cover, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Corcentric off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Mike, quick follow-up for Corcentric.

As new partnerships drive demand, the national pipeline target usually outpaces what the team can cover. Most sales leaders cannot say how many meetings they actually need to hit the number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Corcentric needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Mike, last bit of proof for Corcentric.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Corcentric's reply rate likely compares to other procurement-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?

Mike, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling national pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. A stretch of new partnership launches is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Corcentric either way.
